landing.title: Check a rental listing before you pay.
landing.lead: Many scams start on Facebook or Mudah, then pull you into a private WhatsApp chat and rush you for a deposit. Paste the listing — we'll score the risk in seconds.
landing.step1Desc: Drop in the listing text, or a WhatsApp / Mudah screenshot.
landing.step2Desc: Text, web complaints and the asking price — all checked at once.
landing.step3Desc: A clear 0–100 score with plain-language advice on what to do.

guide.title: User Guide
guide.lead: Five steps, about a minute. Know the risk before you transfer a single ringgit.
guide.step2: Paste your WhatsApp conversation with the suspected agent or landlord — the whole chat, at least 6 messages. Manglish shortforms are expanded before we look for scam tactics.
guide.step2Shots: Only have screenshots? Upload them instead — here's how to take a good one ↓
guide.step3: Enter the agent's phone number and full name, and we search public scam reports for them. Without either, the online check is left out of the score.
guide.step4: Enter the monthly rent, area and property type. We compare the rent with the median for similar units in that area — far below it is a classic bait. The rent is only read from this form, never from the chat.
guide.step5: Click 'Analyse' and review the risk score, the red flags and what was found online.

shots.title: Taking a good chat screenshot
shots.lead: We read the text in your screenshots automatically. The clearer they are, the more accurate your score.
shots.mockLabel: Example WhatsApp chat: the agent offers a KLCC studio for RM750, refuses a viewing, and asks for a RM1,500 deposit first.
shots.point1Text: Screenshots are read for the messages, not the chat header — so type the name and number shown there into Agent details. That's what we search scam reports for.
shots.point2Text: Include the rent offer and what you asked — e.g. asking to view the unit. The price check still uses the rent you type into the form.
shots.point3Text: Deposit, booking fee or "byr dlu" messages are the strongest signals — don't leave them out.
shots.do1: Use your phone's screenshot button — not a photo of the screen.
shots.do2: Take them on your own phone — we tell your messages from the agent's by the bubble colour.
shots.do3: Long chat? Upload up to 20 screenshots, oldest first. A little overlap between them is fine.
shots.do4: Keep each message's timestamp in view — it's how we tell one message from the next.
shots.avoid2: A single message with no context — the text check needs at least 6 messages.
shots.avoid3: Relying on photos the agent sent — we read the typed messages, not text inside pictures.
shots.avoid4: Showing your own IC, bank details or address — cover them first.

guide.scoreLead: Every listing gets a score from 0 to 100. Higher means riskier.
guide.boundary: Each band starts at its number: a score of exactly 25, 50 or 75 goes to the higher band.

bands.LOW: Proceed with standard caution. Verify agent details directly.
bands.MODERATE: Multiple indicators present. Verify REN number, request official receipt, view before paying.
bands.HIGH: Strong warning signs. Get second opinion, do not pay without viewing.
bands.CRITICAL: Avoid this listing. Do not transfer any money. Report to NSRC: 997.

other.title: Other results you may see
other.unknownText: No check could be scored — for example, a short chat with no agent details or rent. It is not a low score: add more of the conversation and the details, then try again.
other.cappedText: The text model rated the chat as risky, but no specific scam tactic was found behind that rating, so the score is held at the top of Medium. Verify the agent and the unit before paying.
other.partialText: A check that couldn't run — no phone or full name to search, say — is left out, not counted as zero. The result says the highest score it could reach.

guide.nsrcText: Call the National Scam Response Centre immediately, then your bank.

about.title: About RentSafe MY
about.lead: A free safety check for Malaysian students and renters — built to catch rental scams before any money changes hands.
about.whyTitle: Scams don't stay on the listing site.
about.whyText: A typical rental scam starts with a cheap, attractive post on Facebook or Mudah. The "agent" then moves you into a private WhatsApp chat — away from any platform protection — and pushes for a deposit before you've seen the unit. Students moving to a new city are the easiest targets.
about.step1Text: Below-market rent on a public listing
about.step2Text: "PM me on WhatsApp" — off the platform
about.step3Text: "Byr dlu deposit, ramai nak" — pay before viewing
about.howTitle: Three checks, one score out of 100
about.howLead: Each check has a maximum, weighted by how strongly it predicts a scam.
about.nlpText: Two layers read the chat, Manglish included. Hand-written rules spot known tactics — payment before viewing, keys by courier, an owner who is "overseas" — and say why. A fine-tuned language model (XLM-RoBERTa) reads the whole chat and gives the points: how likely it is to be a scam.
about.osintText: We search news sites, community forums and social media for scam complaints about the agent's phone number, name, REN number or company. A news report counts most, then a forum post, then social media.
about.priceText: We compare the rent with the median for that area and property type. Far below the median is a classic bait.
about.honest1Text: A check that can't run is left out, not scored as safe — and the result says the highest score it could reach.
about.honest2Text: If the model rates a chat as risky but no specific scam tactic is found, the score is held at Medium and you're asked to verify.
about.honest3Text: The "What this means" explanation is written after the score is calculated, from the result alone. It can't change the score.
about.privacy2: Your chat and screenshots are read by our own OCR and model — never sent to an outside AI.
about.privacy3: Only the agent's phone, name, REN and company are searched on the web. We never contact the agent.
about.limitsTitle: A score is guidance, not a guarantee
about.limitsBefore: A low score doesn't prove a listing is safe. Always view the unit in person, check the agent's REN number on the
about.limitsAfter: , and get an official receipt for any payment.
about.fyp: RentSafe MY is a Final Year Project prototype — not a substitute for your own due diligence.
about.ctaTitle: Found a listing that feels off?
about.ctaText: Check it in under a minute — periksa dulu, baru bayar.
